purpose: List assorted examples amid a busy, mixed, or emotional situation.
keywords: N / plain predicate + やら + N / plain predicate + やら
On moving day, I was busy packing, cleaning, and everything else.
I felt both happy and lonely and could not speak well.
Books, papers, and all sorts of things are piled on the desk.
formation: N / plain predicate + やら + N / plain predicate + やら
restrictions: Often conveys a jumble or mixed feelings; the list is not exhaustive.
mistake: Use と for a simple complete list without this mixed impression.
